narrative:
Carroll County has 17,676 registered voters, with 17.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 46.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 15.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 33.9% of registrants.
